action_chum_the_waters.name: Chum the Waters
action_chum_the_waters.description: Scatter bait across the shallows. The next few Aquatic cards haul in twice the catch — and take twice as long doing it.

action_bountiful_rites.name: Bountiful Rites
action_bountiful_rites.description: A short rite over the tools. The next couple of Gathering cards give more, but demand more.

action_cast_hex.name: Cast Hex
action_cast_hex.description: Mark the next enemy with a slow rot. It enters the fight already poisoned.
